title: 29 PROBLEMS · STAFF CALLS
subtitle: For each problem: the number that decides the design, and the call a staff engineer makes.
footer: Details per problem: the "Staff-level lens" section on each problem page

head: Problem
Deciding number
Staff call
rows: URL shortener (Bitly)
~100k redirects/s peak vs ~12 writes/s; 1B links × 500 B ≈ 500 GB, one Postgres.
Cache-aside Redis plus replicas; counter + base62 with servers leasing ID ranges.
Rate limiter
1M checks/s ≈ 10–20 Redis shards; ~1 GB of bucket state.
Token bucket in a Redis Lua script.
Business discovery (Yelp)
10M businesses × 1 KB ≈ 10 GB; ~20k searches/s at peak.
One Postgres + PostGIS + replicas + page cache.
News feed (Facebook)
115k feed reads/s; ~1.2M feed inserts/s with fan-out on write; celebrities with 100M followers.
Hybrid: push to followers below a threshold (~100k), pull celebrity posts at read.
News aggregator (Google News)
~12k reads/s, 50k+/s on breaking news; ~1 new article/s.
Precompute per region and category, cache at the CDN for ~60 s.
Local delivery (Gopuff)
~10k browse/s at peak vs ~12 orders/s; the 10k-row warehouse list fits in memory.
Browse is AP (cache + replicas); checkout is CP (conditional decrements in one transaction).
Dating app (Tinder)
~100k swipes/s at peak; precomputed stacks ≈ 32 GB.
Precomputed stacks + Bloom filter of swiped profiles; one atomic operation per pair of users for matches.
Distributed cache
1 TB ÷ ~32 GB per node ≈ 32+ nodes; each node ≫ 100k ops/s, so memory sets the count.
Consistent hashing with virtual nodes, async replica per primary.
Top-K videos (YouTube)
70B views/day ≈ 800k/s; 4B videos × 8 B ≈ 32 GB of counters.
Kafka partitioned by video; in-memory counts and local heaps; merge.
Ad click aggregator
10k clicks/s at peak, 100M/day, ~10 GB/day raw.
Kafka → Flink (dedupe by signed impression ID) → OLAP store, plus a nightly batch recount.
Web crawler
~23k pages/s; ~46 GB/s of bandwidth; ~20 PB raw.
Separate fetch and parse stages with queues and raw pages in S3.
Metrics monitoring (Datadog)
5M points/s; ~600 GB/day compressed.
Kafka → time-series DB with compression and downsampling; alerts evaluated on the stream.
Fitness tracking (Strava)
10M activities/day; ~1 TB/day of tracks.
Record on device; idempotent, resumable upload; process asynchronously.
Post search (Facebook)
~12k posts/s and ~10× that in likes.
Inverted index built from the stream, sharded by term; like-based ranking updated in batches or at thresholds.
Price tracker (CamelCamelCamel)
500M products; ~6k pages/s to crawl each one daily.
Crawl by priority (trackers, volatility) + validated crowd-sourced prices + event-driven alerts.

head: Problem
Deciding number
Staff call
rows: Ride sharing (Uber)
250k location writes/s; ~100 ride requests/s on average.
Redis GEO for locations; offer to one driver at a time with a driver lock and conditional assignment; durable…
Live comments (Facebook Live)
1M viewers × 1k comments/s ≈ 1B deliveries/s for one stream.
SSE + pub/sub per video, viewers of a video routed to the same servers; sample comments on mega-streams.
Collaborative editor (Google Docs)
~500 ops/s on a hot document; correctness, not scale.
One owner server per document running OT, with an op log and snapshots.
Stock trading (Robinhood)
Thousands of updates/s across ~10k symbols; 20M users, so push not poll.
Persist the order as pending before calling the exchange, reconcile on timeout; throttle prices per symbol.
Online auction
~1k bids/s on one auction in its final seconds.
Conditional update on the auction row; a Kafka partition per auction for the hottest ones.
LLM chat (ChatGPT)
~12k generations/s, each holding a GPU for seconds.
Priority queue with admission control in front of the GPU pool, streamed tokens.
Chat app (WhatsApp)
~600k messages/s; hundreds of millions of open connections.
WebSockets + user→server registry + per-user pub/sub; persist before ack; an inbox per device.
Ticketmaster
~100k seats vs 10M users: bookings are capped, reads are not.
Conditional-update holds; virtual waiting room; browse is AP, booking is CP.
Payment system (Stripe)
~10k TPS: moderate.
Pending record first, idempotency keys, outbox, double-entry ledger, daily reconciliation.
Online judge (LeetCode)
~100 submissions/s at peak; ~500 sandboxes running at once.
Queue + microVM sandboxes + autoscaling workers.
Job scheduler
864M executions/day.
Time-bucketed store + poller + delay queue + leases.
Video platform (YouTube)
~1 PB/day raw uploads.
Presigned multipart uploads, a segment-parallel transcoding DAG, CDN delivery.
File storage and sync (Dropbox)
A 50 GB file is ~10k chunks; a 1-byte edit changes one chunk.
Content-defined chunking with dedupe, a change log with cursors.
Photo sharing (Instagram)
~115k feed reads/s; ~200 TB/day of media.
Presigned uploads, async processing, CDN; hybrid fan-out.
